r.t: Hi Guys, Normally, I'm not used to writing a very detailed formal character analysis document, and if I were to make a character like this, I'm sure it wouldn't be a character like Nate River, which we would get bored with. I just remembered that Nate River was underrated for no reason, and I wondered how you thought about Evolved Matsuda's Theory(My theory), by adding a few theories of my own and presenting it to you again. It will sound like conversation like this. Enjoy reading.

First, let's talk about Matsuda's theory. According to Matsuda, after Near obtained the real notebook after Mikami's mistake, he wrote Mikami's name in the notebook as arriving on January 28th without testing, aiming to win flawlessly. Our theory is that Near was the one who planned everything. According to our theory, Near perfectly deduced Light Yagami's personality from the very first conversation and the general guests. Presumably, he later guessed that Light Yagami would collaborate with people like Tadaka and Mikami due to pressure. Deducing this from just phone conversations is a remarkable feat of emotional perception. To explain further, Near likely knew that Light Yagami was cornered and that Near thought he would switch the notebooks when he had the opportunity. Therefore, he gave Mikami the real notebook. He must have guessed that he wouldn't let her use it. Near had already understood from the photos in the recordings that he would empathize with Light and choose Mikami, then listened to the conversation and approved it (Ep, empathy feat). This wasn't all Near understood here. Near only saw a video recording and only Light Yagami's voice. He saw a possible relationship between Mikami and Light Yagami, Mikami making some decisions on his own because Light was already in a tight position. Even if Light didn't order this, he probably understood that Mikami was pleased with this behavior and that it would happen. As you've noticed, there's a blind spot here. Even though Light Yagami doesn't like Mikami acting on his own, he's happy as long as the results are good and he slowly starts to care about it. Therefore, a blind spot that can be used in the future is born. In a way, Light Yagami has this in mind. He's starting to unnecessarily trust Mikami and no longer care about the possibility of him making a mistake. Near senses this too. That's why Near knows that if Tadaka is kidnapped, Light will kill Tadaka, but Mikami will think Light's hands are tied again, as before, and will take the real notebook from where he hid it and kill him. For this, Tadaka needs to be kidnapped at exactly the perfect time. If he's kidnapped too long before the meeting, he could attract attention and the precautions could increase. Here, another important feat comes into play. Near manipulates Mello throughout the series to keep the kidnapping secret. This is already known, regardless of the theory. He unravels the connection between Mello and the female agent long beforehand, and by specifically ensuring he obtains information, I suspect he predicts Mello's kidnapping. Furthermore, Near deliberately sets up a meeting between the female agent and Mello, which Mello doesn't realize for a long time (which is a magnificent anticaption feat). He tells Lighta the exact date. In this way, Mello manipulates Mikami into killing Tadaka, exploiting his blind spot and ensuring Light never finds out.
Let's get to the basis of the theory.

While this theory is completely random, it certainly has some basis. As you know, there are details like Near manipulating Mello, Near understanding Mikami's personality, and moving the date of the meeting to two days after Mello kidnapped Tadaka (Mikami hadn't even shown the notebook when he arranged this date). So, it's truly strange that Near created a gap of a full day when he knew Mello had kidnapped Tadaka. He's also aware of Mikami's tendency to act on his own initiative. And since he specifically arranged for Mello to do this and knew Mikami would react to it, and also knew that Light was probably aware of his plan to switch notebooks, I don't think there's any reason why this theory is false. It's a theory, after all. In other words, I think Near, who understands everything, is like that. In my opinion, there's no reason why he can't make a plan. This feat buffs categories like Near's
(ep, eu, ef). I'm looking forward to your opinions and objections, and we'll discuss them in the comments section.

As a result, I think Nate can surpass many characters including Light(manga) in the scd. I also think I will make a Light concealment analysis that no one has talked about in the community. Probably in the coming days, that Light yagami Concealment Doc and Light Yagami vs Nate River docu will be shared in the community. Thank you for reading.
